about:
Hansen Advertising, Inc. has operated from Willmar, Minnesota since its founding in 1962. The company remains family-owned and is now in its third generation of ownership.

The firm supplies custom-imprinted promotional products and branded apparel to organizations ranging from schools and churches to corporate clients. Its in-house graphic artist assists with logo creation and artwork preparation, while a physical showroom lets buyers examine samples before ordering. Sales representatives consult on product selection, handle customization, and can deliver or mail samples by appointment.

Customers include educational institutions, religious groups, businesses planning trade shows or employee-recognition programs, and event organizers for weddings, casino nights, and sports tournaments. The company also develops promotional programs for product launches, conferences, and volunteer-appreciation campaigns.

Hansen Advertising emphasizes long-term relationships as its guiding principle. Staff attend industry trade shows and seminars to track trends, and the showroom-plus-sample-delivery model aims to give buyers hands-on confidence before committing to an order.
